voyage.name: Roman Theatre
voyage.content: The Roman Theatre, discovered in the 1970s during a construction project, is part of the pedestrian zone, and typically has merchants selling art and other items nearby.

voyage.name: St. Marina church
voyage.content: It has a unique wooden tower.

voyage.name: Church of St Constantine and Helena
Bishop's Basilica of Philippopolis
voyage.content: Rich Roman mosaics from late antiquity.

voyage.name: Adisa
voyage.content: Folk-style snack bar, very nice place. There is a wide selection of vegetarian and local dishes. At noon there is a queue when everyone goes on a break to eat.

voyage.name: Elegant Chinese Restaurant
voyage.content: Very tasty food, the staff is very smiling and kind. The place maybe is not the most charming but the waitress is nice.

voyage.name: White Spider Pub
voyage.content: Strangely pleasant restaurant. Unique place. Unique atmosphere. Underground for more than a century.

voyage.name: Restaurant Uncles
voyage.content: A great restaurant at the Maritsa river with very good fish cuisine. Friendly welcome. Restaurant with service and cuisine with Bulgarian spirit...

voyage.name: Unico
voyage.content: A very good Italian restaurant in the centre. They have a good and affordable menu.

voyage.name: Smokini
voyage.content: Previously called "Chuchura". Features a mixture between traditional Bulgarian cuisine and international delicacies. The interior is spacious with industrial and vintage decoration.

voyage.name: Zanzibar
voyage.content: Club Zanzibar contains a stylish African interior Cocktail Bar, which offers drinks, and at night time offers the largest nightclub in Plovdiv.

voyage.name: Kapana District
voyage.content: If you want to immerse yourself in the liveliest area in Plovdiv, head to the Kapana creative district. It used to be a neglected area in the centre of Plovdiv but has become the cultural heart of the city.

voyage.name: The Crib Hostel
voyage.content: 2-min walk from the city centre with a fantastic view of the Old Town from the rooftop and every bedroom. Friendly staff is always available. Clean, modern, cheerful place with free Wi-Fi everywhere, a nice common room, and a great top floor and tiled roof to chill on. Open kitchen for use, free lockers, and free washing service available.

voyage.name: Hiker's Hostel
voyage.price: 22 лв per person per night with free breakfast
voyage.content: Very helpful and friendly staff. Centrally located and if there is no room they will provide tents in the garden. Will also organize trips to a number of local attractions if you can find a few people to go with you.

voyage.name: Saborna 25 Guest House
voyage.content: Twelve rooms in the Old Town. Aa hotel and a place for cultural activities and meetings, a tourist information centre, exhibition hall with a stand for selling pieces of art and souvenirs, art cafe with a gallery. The art cafe (24 seats) is used for breakfast and for exhibitions, seminars, literature readings and other cultural events. The rooms are very clean and shiny. Each has its own colour and spirit.

voyage.name: Puldin House
voyage.content: Guest house with four self-contained apartments (studio to two-bedroom, sleeping 3 to 6), each with its own bathroom, kitchen or kitchenette, air conditioning and Wi-Fi; some have a balcony or terrace. Self check-in with a key lockbox. Garden with barbecue. Free public parking zone nearby (no reservation). Pets allowed for a fee.
